  Page

  Unavailable
  InvalidRequest
  RecordTooLarge
  Corrupt
  Unsupported
  pub const ALL: [Self; 7]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>

pub struct Attestation
  by: ::std::string::String
  verified: bool
  hop: i64
  program: ::std::string::String
  host: ::std::string::String
  user: ::std::string::String
  exe: ::std::string::String
  uid: i64
  gid: i64
  pid: i64
  key: ::std::string::String
  mac: ::std::string::String
pub struct Record
  schema: i64
  time: ::std::string::String
  level: i64
  msg: ::std::string::String
  identity: ::std::vec::Vec<Attestation>
  job: ::std::string::String
  attrs: ::std::collections::BTreeMap<::std::string::String, ::std::string::String>
pub struct Page
  outcome: PageOutcome
  records: ::std::vec::Vec<Record>
  next: ::std::string::String
  at_end: bool
pub struct HistoryUsage
  retained_bytes: i64
  oldest: ::std::string::String
  max_use: ::std::option::Option<i64>
  max_retention_ms: ::std::option::Option<i64>
pub struct HistoryUsageResult
  outcome: HistoryUsageOutcome
  usage: ::std::option::Option<HistoryUsage>
pub struct ApplicationLogTarget
  selection: ApplicationLogSelection
  program: ::std::string::String
pub struct ApplicationLogResource
  program: ::std::string::String
  captured_file_key: ::std::string::String
pub struct ApplicationLogPage
  outcome: HistoryPageOutcome
  records: ::std::vec::Vec<Record>
  next: ::std::string::String
  at_end: bool
pub struct SourceDescriptor
  id: ::std::string::String
  availability: SourceAvailability
  limitations: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
pub struct SourceCatalog
  sources: ::std::vec::Vec<SourceDescriptor>
  outcome: SourceCatalogOutcome
pub struct ProducerClaim
  provider: ::std::string::String
  program: ::std::string::String
  exe: ::std::string::String

  pid: i64
  uid: i64
  gid: i64
pub struct SourceRecord
  source_id: ::std::string::String
  record: Record
  producer: ::std::option::Option<ProducerClaim>
pub struct SourcePage
  outcome: HistoryPageOutcome

  next: ::std::string::String
  at_end: bool
pub fn encode(v: &Record) -> ::std::vec::Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal

  offset: usize

  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
